biggest_catch: Stipends are modest: $100 for a 15.5-hour Election Day plus $20 in-person training class and $25 online training (with score of 80% or higher).
catches: Poll Place Clerk Election Day stipend is $100 for the full day (6:00 AM to 9:30 PM).
Training pay is per class: $20 per in-person class, $25 per online class passed with a score of 80% or higher.
Online training duration is not stated; time counted includes only the ~2-hour in-person class plus Election Day.
Student rates use the same stipend table ($100 Election Day); students have additional eligibility requirements.
Stipends are paid approximately six weeks after the election (per county's 2025 poll worker materials, not on the stipend page itself).

steps: Apply as a poll worker to the Solano County Registrar of Voters.
Complete an in-person training class ($20) and an online training course ($25 with score 80% or higher).
Work the full Election Day as a Poll Place Clerk (6:00 AM to 9:30 PM).
Receive stipends totaling up to $145 ($100 day + $20 in-person + $25 online).
timing: Election Day 6:00 AM-9:30 PM (15.5 hours) plus one ~2-hour in-person training class (online class duration unstated).
weasel_words: Online training duration is not stated, so its time is not counted beyond the $25 payment.
The $25 online training payment requires a score of 80% or higher.
Student applicants follow the same stipend table but have separate school-based eligibility requirements.
Election Day hours (6 AM-9:30 PM) are from the county's poll worker application, not the stipend table itself.
